=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- File: scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py
  Line or code reference: lines ~71-79 (load_optional_overrides function)
  Problem: `load_optional_overrides` lacks a type guard before `payload.get("models", [])`, so malformed YAML can crash generation
  Why it fails at runtime: A non-dict payload can abort `make generate` with an internal error instead of a user-friendly validation failure
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py
  Line or code reference: lines 131-134 (function sanitize_table_cell)
  Problem: `sanitize_table_cell` collapses consecutive whitespace before escaping pipes, which mangles note text
  Why it fails at runtime: The generated markdown loses intended spacing and readability in table cells
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: docs/codex-model-reference.md
  Line or code reference: table row | openai/gpt-5.4 | ... | notes column
  Problem: The frozen note text omits backticks around quoted identifiers
  Why it fails at runtime: Readers cannot easily distinguish tokens from prose, reducing clarity in the generated reference
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- File: scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py
  Line or code reference: Lines 71-79 (load_optional_overrides function)
  Problem: Missing type guard before payload.get() - while there is a None check and isinstance(payload, dict) check, these occur AFTER lines 76-77 where yaml.safe_load could return non-dict types that would fail on the isinstance check path, but critically the error message generation assumes payload is dict-like.
  Why it fails at runtime: Malformed YAML that parses to a list or string would trigger unclear error messages through the fail() function rather than graceful handling.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py
  Line or code reference: Lines 124-126 (sanitize_table_cell function)
  Problem: The function collapses all consecutive whitespace to single spaces via " ".join(text.split()), which destroys intentional formatting in multi-line notes.
  Why it fails at runtime: The frozen note in docs/codex-model-reference.md shows collapsed spacing that reduces readability of the explanation text.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Update scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py only as needed so render-time overrides are merged, per-row notes are surfaced, and rows with one or more overridden fields are marked (frozen) in the generated doc."

  Evidence of absence: The banner still only mentions codex_model_catalog.json and codex_model_catalog_overrides.yaml, but per the PR description there are TWO override surfaces - the second being prompts/.overrides.yaml which is not mentioned in the generator banner or documentation.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: Create scripts/codex_model_catalog_overrides.yaml and prompts/.overrides.yaml - these new files should be tracked in the workspace source manifest per Copilot review comment entry[1].
  Expected change site: .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt
  Evidence of absence: Neither prompts/.overrides.yaml nor scripts/codex_model_catalog_overrides.yaml appears in the committed manifest. The manifest was only touched to alphabetically re-sort tests/test_record_id_format_contract.py.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Regenerate docs/codex-model-reference.md" with frozen marker and per-row notes.
  Expected change site: docs/codex-model-reference.md row for openai/gpt-5.4
  Evidence of absence: The generated note text contains technical identifiers like freeform, function, codex#11151 without backtick formatting, making them harder to distinguish from prose. The issue acceptance criteria implies proper formatting of technical terms.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
